approval_steps_source_kind_check.name: approval_steps_source_kind_check

budget_codes_department_or_project_check.name: budget_codes_department_or_project_check
budget_codes_department_or_project_check.value: (department_id is not null) <> (project_id is not null)

departments_parent_not_self_check.name: departments_parent_not_self_check
departments_parent_not_self_check.value: parent_department_id is null or parent_department_id <> id

expense_requests_po_xor_budget_code_chec.name: expense_requests_po_xor_budget_code_check
expense_requests_po_xor_budget_code_chec.value: (purchase_order_id is not null) or (budget_code_id is not null)

form_definitions_deleted_check.name: form_definitions_deleted_check
form_definitions_deleted_check.value: (deleted_at is null) = (deleted_by_employee_id is null) and (deleted_at is null or status = 'archived')

form_definitions_published_check.name: form_definitions_published_check
form_definitions_published_check.value: status <> 'published' or published_version_id is not null

identity_link_requests_decision_check.name: identity_link_requests_decision_check
identity_link_requests_decision_check.value: (status = 'pending') = (decided_at is null) and (status = 'approved') = (approved_employee_id is not null)

purchase_orders_payment_terms_check.name: purchase_orders_payment_terms_check
purchase_orders_payment_terms_check.value: payment_terms in ('預付款', '貨到付款', '月結30天', '月結45天', '月結60天', '其他')

travel_expense_cost_items_category_check.name: travel_expense_cost_items_category_check
